name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families across the country.
target_audience: Small and marginal farmers holding cultivable land
benefits: ₹6,000 per annum paid directly to bank account in 3 installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months.
documents_required: Active Bank Account with Aadhaar Seeded
application_steps: Visit pmkisan.gov.in and click on 'New Farmer Registration'.
Enter Aadhaar Number, select State, and verify captcha.
Fill in land record details (Khasra/Khata number) and bank details.
Submit for Patwari/State nodal officer verification.
Check status on the 'Beneficiary Status' portal using Aadhaar or Phone number.

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: World's largest health assurance scheme providing health cover of ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
target_audience: Economically vulnerable families identified via SECC database and senior citizens aged 70+
benefits: Cashless in-patient treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year at empaneled public and private hospitals across India.
application_steps: Check eligibility at beneficiary.nha.gov.in using Aadhaar, Ration card or mobile number.
Visit any empaneled government/private hospital or Common Service Centre (CSC).
Complete e-KYC via Aadhaar OTP or biometric scan.
Download the Ayushman Card instantly on mobile or obtain printed PVC card.
Present Ayushman Card at hospital Ayushman Mitra desk for cashless admission.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Assistance to urban poor families (EWS/LIG/MIG) for constructing, purchasing, or enhancing pucca houses with interest subsidy or direct assistance.
target_audience: Urban homeless and slum dwellers with no pucca house anywhere in India
benefits: Credit Linked Subsidy (CLSS) up to ₹2.67 Lakh on home loan interest or up to ₹1.5 Lakh grant for beneficiary-led construction.
documents_required: Land title or allotment letter (if applicable)
Affidavit that applicant does not own a pucca house
application_steps: Visit pmaymis.gov.in or nearest CSC/Municipality office.
Select 'Citizen Assessment' and enter 12-digit Aadhaar number.
Fill personal, income, family, and current residence details.
Save application and note the 15-digit Application ID.
Physical verification is conducted by ULB municipal officers.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Financial assistance to rural homeless and those living in kutcha/dilapidated houses for construction of a 25 sq.m pucca house.
target_audience: Rural families living in kutcha houses without adult earning members
benefits: ₹1,20,000 in plains and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult regions, plus 90-95 days of unskilled labor wages under MGNREGA and ₹12,000 for toilet construction.
documents_required: Gram Panchayat recommendation / Awaas+ list entry
application_steps: Beneficiary list is prepared by Gram Sabha from SECC / Awaas+ survey.
Contact Gram Panchayat Secretary or Block Development Officer (BDO).
Geo-tagging of the kutcha house site before construction.
Funds transferred directly in milestones: plinth level, roof level, completion.
Track progress using AwaasSoft portal or AwaasApp.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Deposit-free LPG connections along with free first refill and hotplate to adult women from poor households to ensure clean cooking fuel.
target_audience: Adult women of poor households without an active LPG connection
benefits: Free LPG gas connection, safety hose, regulator, first 14.2kg cylinder refill, and cooking gas stove (chulha). Subsidized refills via DBTL.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of the woman applicant
Self-declaration for migrant families if address differs
application_steps: Visit pmuy.gov.in or your local LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas).
Fill Ujjwala 2.0 application form (available in local languages).
Submit Aadhaar, Ration Card, and bank account details.
Distributor performs de-duplication and eKYC check.
Receive connection kit with cylinder and stove at doorstep.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Collateral-free loans up to ₹20 Lakh to non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises under Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories.
target_audience: Small business owners, shopkeepers, artisans, street vendors, and entrepreneurs
benefits: Shishu: up to ₹50,000; Kishore: ₹50,001 to ₹5,00,000; Tarun: ₹5,00,001 to ₹10,00,000 (extended up to ₹20 Lakh in 2024 budget) with no collateral requirement.
documents_required: Business Quotation / Machinery Invoice / Expansion Plan
application_steps: Apply online at udyamimitra.in portal or visit nearest bank/NBFC.
Select loan tier: Shishu, Kishore, or Tarun.
Submit business plan, cost estimate, and identification documents.
Bank evaluates proposal and sanctions loan within 7-10 working days.
MUDRA Card (debit card for working capital) is issued.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Micro-credit facility for street vendors to access affordable working capital loans with interest subsidy and digital transaction cashback incentives.
target_audience: Urban street vendors vending on or before March 24, 2020
benefits: 1st tranche ₹10,000; 2nd tranche ₹20,000; 3rd tranche ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy and up to ₹1,200 annual cashback for digital UPI payments.
documents_required: Vending Certificate or ID card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB)
application_steps: Check vending certificate / Letter of Recommendation (LoR) status at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in.
Apply online or through Municipal Corporation ward office / CSC.
Select preferred Lending Institution (Public/Private Bank, SHG, MFI).
Upload documents and submit.
Loan disbursed directly to bank account within 3-5 days.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: End-to-end holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople engaged in 18 trades including training, toolkit incentive, and collateral-free enterprise credit.
target_audience: Traditional craftspeople: carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, sculptors, cobblers, masons, tailors, etc.
benefits: Skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 toolkit e-voucher, collateral-free loans up to ₹3,00,000 at concessional 5% interest rate, and marketing support.
application_steps: Visit pmvishwakarma.gov.in or nearby Common Service Centre (CSC).
Complete Aadhaar biometric authentication.
Select your traditional trade from the 18 eligible categories.
Application is verified at Gram Panchayat / ULB level and District committee.
Receive Vishwakarma Certificate, ID card, and schedule for 5-7 days basic training.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Small deposit savings scheme for girl children as part of 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' campaign offering high government-backed interest and tax exemption.
target_audience: Parents/legal guardians of girl children aged below 10 years
benefits: Current interest rate of 8.2% p.a. (compounded annually), 100% tax exemption under Section 80C (EEE status), maturity after 21 years or on marriage.
documents_required: Aadhaar / ID Proof of Parent or Legal Guardian
Passport size photos of child and guardian
application_steps: Visit any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch.
Collect and fill Form-1 (Sukanya Samriddhi Account Opening Form).
Attach child's birth certificate and guardian's KYC documents.
Make initial deposit (minimum ₹250, maximum ₹1.5 Lakh per fiscal year).
Passbook is issued for tracking deposits and interest.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / PFRDA
description: Universal guaranteed pension scheme for unorganized sector workers ensuring defined monthly pension from age 60.
target_audience: Indian citizens aged 18-40 working in the unorganized or private sector (non-income tax payers)
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 starting from age 60 till lifetime; spouse gets same pension upon death; nominee gets accumulated corpus.
documents_required: Mobile Number linked to Bank Account
application_steps: Visit your bank branch or use Net Banking / mobile banking app.
Fill APY subscriber registration form and choose desired pension amount (₹1k-₹5k).
Set auto-debit frequency (monthly, quarterly, or half-yearly).
Receive Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) confirmation SMS.
Contributions auto-debited based on entry age.

name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
description: Contributory pension scheme for unorganized workers earning up to ₹15,000 monthly, with matching 50% contribution from Central Government.
target_audience: Unorganized workers aged 18 to 40 years earning <= ₹15,000/month
benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 upon reaching age 60, with 50% family pension to spouse in case of subscriber demise.
documents_required: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account with IFSC
application_steps: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or maandhan.in.
Provide Aadhaar number and savings bank account details.
First contribution amount (₹55 to ₹200 depending on age) paid in cash at CSC.
Auto-debit mandate signed and biometric verification done.
Unique Shram Yogi Pension Card is printed and handed over immediately.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Comprehensive agricultural crop insurance against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest stages at nominal premium.
target_audience: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops
benefits: Farmers pay very low premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops; full claim settlement for localized calamity, drought, pest attack, flood.
documents_required: Land Possession Certificate / Land Tenancy Agreement
Sowing Certificate issued by Patwari / Village Revenue Officer
application_steps: Apply through pmfby.gov.in, nearest bank branch, or CSC within cut-off date.
Enter land details, survey number, and insured crop name.
Pay nominal farmer share premium online or at branch.
Policy certificate generated with Crop Insurance Application number.
Report crop damage within 72 hours via Crop Insurance Mobile App in event of localized disaster.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC/ST/OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Financial assistance to enable students from marginalized sections to complete post-matriculation or post-secondary education including degree, diploma, and technical courses.
target_audience: SC, ST, and OBC students pursuing higher secondary, college, or university education
benefits: Full compulsory non-refundable course fees coverage plus monthly maintenance allowance (up to ₹13,500/year for hostellers). Directly transferred via DBT.
documents_required: Caste Certificate issued by authorized tehsildar/revenue officer
College Admission Fee Receipt & Fee Structure
Aadhaar Card & Bank Account linked to Aadhaar
application_steps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Fill student profile and select Scheme category based on caste.
Upload caste certificate, income proof, and marksheets.
Submit application; verification conducted by institute nodal officer.
District and state welfare officers approve before DBT fund release.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Skill certification initiative enabling Indian youth to take up industry-relevant short-term skill training and Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) to secure livelihood.
target_audience: Unemployed youth, school/college dropouts aged 15-45 looking for employment or self-employment skills
benefits: Free skill training, government-recognized skill certificate, assessment fees waived, monetary reward upon certification, and job placement assistance.
documents_required: Education qualification marksheets (10th/12th/Graduation or dropout proof)
application_steps: Visit skillindia.gov.in or pmkvyofficial.org.
Search for nearby training centers (PMKK) by sector (IT, Healthcare, Automotive, Solar, Retail).
Enroll for desired Short Term Training (STT) course.
Attend classes (typically 200-400 hours) and practical training.
Pass final third-party assessment and receive National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF) certificate.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.
target_audience: Women and SC/ST entrepreneurs starting manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading businesses
benefits: Composite loan (term loan + working capital) between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore, repayment period up to 7 years with maximum 18 months moratorium, lowest applicable interest rates.
documents_required: Detailed Project Report (DPR) for the new enterprise
Proof of business address and lease/ownership deeds
application_steps: Register on standupmitra.in portal.
Fill online application form and choose 'Trainee' or 'Ready' borrower.
Select target bank branch or forward to multiple lenders.
Attend interview / presentation with branch manager.
Credit guarantee cover through NCGTC upon sanction.

name: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
description: Providing safe and adequate drinking water through individual Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTC) to every rural household across India.
target_audience: Rural households currently without piped tap water supply
benefits: Free or low-cost piped drinking water connection providing 55 liters per capita per day of potable quality water directly at household tap.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of Head of Family
application_steps: Verify coverage in your village on ejalshakti.gov.in dashboard.
Contact the Village Water and Sanitation Committee (VWSC) or Gram Panchayat.
Submit application with household identification.
Gram Panchayat approves plumbing connection from distribution mains.
Water quality tested periodically using Field Test Kits (FTK) by local women groups.

name: PM-KUSUM (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
description: Solar pumps and solarization of existing grid-connected agricultural pumps with up to 60% government subsidy to eliminate diesel irrigation costs.
target_audience: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, cooperatives, and Water User Associations (WUAs)
benefits: 60% subsidy (30% Central + 30% State), 30% bank loan, farmer pays only 10% cost. Additional income by selling surplus solar electricity to DISCOMs.
documents_required: Electricity Bill (for pump solarization under Component C)
application_steps: Visit state renewable energy development agency portal (e.g. UPNEDA, MEDA, HAREDA).
Select Component: Standalone solar pump (Component B) or Grid pump solarization (Component C).
Fill online application and upload land records.
Pay 10% farmer share after document verification.
Empaneled vendor installs solar panels and pump within 60 days.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Adequate and timely short-term credit to farmers for crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses, animal husbandry, and fisheries at subsidized 4% effective interest rate.
target_audience: All farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and SHGs of farmers
benefits: Revolving credit up to ₹3 Lakh at concessional interest (7% with 3% prompt repayment incentive = 4% net interest rate). Collateral-free up to ₹1.60 Lakh.
documents_required: Land Records (7/12 extract, Patta, or tenancy agreement)
application_steps: Download one-page KCC application form from bank website or pmkisan.gov.in.
Fill land holding, crop details, and existing loans info.
Submit to commercial bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or Cooperative bank.
Bank verifies land records and sanctions card within 14 days.
RuPay KCC debit card issued for ATM cash withdrawal and fertilizer purchases.

name: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman / Mid-Day Meal)
ministry: Ministry of Education
description: Hot cooked nutritional meals to children studying in government and government-aided schools (Classes I to VIII) to improve nutritional status and school enrollment.
target_audience: Schoolchildren aged 6 to 14 years in Classes I to VIII
benefits: Free nutritious lunch on all school days providing minimum 450 calories and 12g protein for primary, 700 calories and 20g protein for upper primary students.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card (optional for mid-day meal receipt)
application_steps: Enroll child in any Government or Government-Aided primary/upper primary school.
Benefit is provided automatically to every attending student daily.
Parents can participate in School Management Committee (SMC) to inspect food quality and hygiene.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Monthly social security pension for senior citizens living below poverty line without any primary family breadwinner.
target_audience: Senior citizens aged 60 years or above belonging to BPL households
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹200 to ₹500 (Central share) topped up by State Government share (totaling ₹1,000 to ₹3,000/month depending on state) paid directly via DBT.
documents_required: BPL Ration Card or BPL Survey number
Age Proof certificate (birth certificate or medical board certificate)
application_steps: Collect application form from local Gram Panchayat or Municipality/Ward office.
Attach BPL proof, age proof, and Aadhaar card.
Submit to Block Development Officer (BDO) in rural areas or Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) in urban areas.
Verification conducted by social welfare inspector.
Pension credited every month directly to savings account.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Social security monthly pension assistance for destitute widows living Below Poverty Line.
target_audience: Widowed women aged 40-79 years belonging to BPL households
benefits: Monthly financial assistance (Central + State combined ₹1,000 - ₹2,500/month) credited directly to bank account.
application_steps: Obtain application form from District Social Welfare Office or Gram Panchayat.
Attach husband's death certificate and BPL ration card.
Verification by Panchayat Secretary or municipal inspector.
Approval by District Collector / Social Welfare Officer.
DBT monthly disbursement begins.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Credit-linked subsidy scheme for generating self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm sectors.
target_audience: Any individual above 18 years aiming to set up a new manufacturing or service enterprise
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 25% (general category in urban) up to 35% (special categories / rural) on projects up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 Lakh for service units.
documents_required: Educational Qualification Certificate (8th pass minimum for projects > ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing)
Special Category / Caste Certificate (if claiming 35% subsidy)
application_steps: Apply online on the KVIC portal (kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal).
Fill Agency selection (KVIC, KVIB, DIC) and project details.
Upload project report, photo, and KYC proofs.
District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) evaluates application and forwards to bank.
Bank sanctions loan and 3-year locked margin money subsidy is released.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Scheme to promote apprenticeship training by incentivizing employers and providing stipend support to youth learning on-the-job industrial skills.
target_audience: Youth who have completed 5th/8th/10th/12th/ITI/Diploma or Graduation seeking industry exposure
benefits: Direct benefit stipend support of 25% of prescribed stipend up to ₹1,500/month paid directly by Government to apprentice bank account, plus hands-on industrial skills and certificate.
documents_required: Educational Certificates (ITI, Diploma, Degree, or 10th mark sheet)
application_steps: Register as candidate on apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.
Complete eKYC via Aadhaar.
Browse and apply for apprenticeship vacancies across companies and sectors.
Sign apprenticeship contract generated digitally by employer.
Receive monthly stipend with government DBT share.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Flagship scheme to bring Blue Revolution through sustainable and responsible development of fisheries sector with infrastructure and financial incentives.
target_audience: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, SHGs, and fisheries cooperatives
benefits: Government financial assistance of 40% for general category and 60% for SC/ST/Women for fish ponds, biofloc units, cages, refrigerated transport vehicles, and fishing gear.
documents_required: Fisherman Registration ID or Land/Pond Ownership/Lease papers
application_steps: Visit pmmsy.dof.gov.in or State Fisheries Department office.
Submit Self-Financed or Credit-Linked project proposal.
District Fisheries Development Officer evaluates feasibility.
Approval by State Level Approval Committee (SLAC).
Subsidy released in installments based on physical verification.

name: Rythu Bandhu / Rythu Bharosa (Telangana & AP)
ministry: State Department of Agriculture
description: Investment support scheme for agriculture and horticulture crops to relieve farmers from debt burden.
target_audience: Land-owning farmers in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh
benefits: ₹10,000 to ₹13,500 per acre per year directly deposited into farmer bank accounts prior to Kharif and Rabi seasons for purchasing seeds, fertilizer, and labor.
application_steps: Submit Pattadar passbook and Aadhaar to Village Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO).
Verification of land records with Dharani / Revenue portal.
Direct DBT credit initiated at the beginning of each cropping season.

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu
description: Universal monthly basic income rights grant recognizing the unpaid domestic labor of women heads of households.
target_audience: Female heads of family residing in Tamil Nadu with family annual income < ₹2.5 Lakh
benefits: ₹1,000 per month deposited directly into the bank account of the woman head of the family on the 15th of every month.
documents_required: Tamil Nadu Smart Family Ration Card
application_steps: Collect token and application form at local Fair Price Shop (Ration shop).
Attend special ward/village camp organized by Revenue Department.
Submit biometric/Aadhaar verification with mobile phone.
SMS confirmation of grant sanction received.
Monthly ₹1,000 transferred via DBT.
